mapper.select: SELECT kp_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, ROUND(AVG(mastery), 1) AS avg_mastery, ROUND(SUM(correct_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(attempts), 0), 1) AS accuracy FROM t_knowledge_mastery WHERE course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY kp_name ORDER BY avg_mastery ASC

SELECT u.nickname, COUNT(p.id) AS practice_count, ROUND(AVG(p.score), 1) AS avg_score, MAX(p.score) AS max_score FROM t_practice p LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname ORDER BY practice_count DESC

SELECT scene, COUNT(*) AS call_count, ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens FROM t_llm_call_log WHERE (#{scene} IS NULL OR scene = #{scene}) GROUP BY scene ORDER BY call_count DESC
